agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  OCTOBER 13, 2026 – 6:00 P.M.
  CITY HALL COMMUNITY ROOM
  9701 LAS TUNAS DRIVE - TEMPLE CITY

PUBLIC PARTICIPATION AND REMOTE ACCESS INSTRUCTIONS
Pursuant to California law, this meeting will be conducted in a hybrid format, allowing both in-
person and remote participation.

IN-PERSON PARTICIPATION
Members of the public may attend the meeting in person at City Hall Community Room and
provide public comment by submitting a speaker card to the City Clerk prior to the item being
considered.

WRITTEN COMMENT
Written public comments received by 5pm on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City
Council and made part of the meeting record. Written public comments will not be read aloud by
city staff or City Council.

REMOTE PARTICIPATION (ZOOM)
Members of the public may participate in the meeting via Zoom using the following information:
• Zoom Link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82314933364, Webinar/Meeting ID: 823 1493 3364

To provide public comment via Zoom:
1. Click the Zoom link or join using the Meeting ID.
2. Your microphone will be unmuted during one of the comment period outlined above. The City
  Clerk will add your name to the speaker list and you will be called upon to make a comment.
  When called, you will be unmuted and given the opportunity to speak.

TELEPHONE PARTICIPATION
Members of the public may also participate by telephone:

•  Dial: 1-669-900-6833
•  Enter Meeting ID when prompted - 823 1493 3364
•  Press *9 to raise your hand to speak.

PUBLIC COMMENT PROCEDURES
Public comments will be taken in the order received, including both in-person and remote
speakers.

• Each speaker will be limited to 3 minutes unless otherwise determined by the Mayor.
• The City will make reasonable efforts to ensure that remote public comment is provided on an
  equal basis with in-person comment.
   City Council Agenda
  October 13, 2026
  Page 2 of 7

You have the opportunity to address the City Council at the following times:

•  Agenda item: at the time the Council considers the agenda item;
•  Non-agenda item: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while the City Council
  values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the Council cannot take action on any item not
  listed on the agenda; and
•  Public Hearing: at the time for public hearings under PUBLIC HEARING.

  The listing of any item on the agenda includes the authority of the Council to take action
  on such item and to approve, disapprove, or give directions on any item

  SUBMISSION OF WRITTEN COMMENTS
  Written comments may be submitted in advance to cityclerk@templecityca.gov 24 hours prior
  to the meeting. Written comments will be distributed to the City Council but will not be read
  aloud by staff or the City Council.

  TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS
  In the event of a disruption to the Zoom platform or telephone access that prevents public
  participation, the City Council will take appropriate steps to restore access. If access cannot be
  restored, the meeting may be recessed or adjourned to ensure compliance with applicable
  law.

  ACCESSIBILITY
  Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), if you require special assistance to
  participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (626) 285-2171 or via email
  at cityclerk@templecityca.gov at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.

  NOTICE: Staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business of this
  Agenda are available for viewing on the City’s website at templecityca.gov and are on file and
  available for review during regular office hours in the Office of the City Clerk located at City Hall,
  9701 Las Tunas Drive, Temple City, California. Written documentation submitted to the City
  Council after distribution of the agenda packet can be obtained at the City Clerk’s Office during
  regular office hours.

  TO WATCH COUNCIL MEETINGS LIVE OR RECORDED, VISIT
  https://www.youtube.com/@ConnectWithTC

  AGENDA NOTIFICATION SUBSCRIPTION
  If you wish to receive an agenda email notification, please email your request to
  cityclerk@templecity.us or call (626) 285-2171.

  All Consent Calendar items may be approved in a single motion as recommended unless

  Recommendation:  Approve Items A through I per recommendations.

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The City Council is requested to review and approve the Minutes of:

  1. The Special City Council Meeting of September 15, 2026;
  2. The Regular City Council Meeting of September 15, 2026; and
  3. The Special City Council Meeting of September 30, 2026.

  Recommendation:  Approve the Minutes of the City Council Meetings.

  Attachments:  September 15 Draft Closed Session Minutes
  (PDF)
  September 15 Draft Regular Meeting Minutes
  (PDF)
  September 30 Draft Special Meeting Minutes

  B. ACCEPTANCE OF FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 PAVEMENT REHABILITATION
  PROJECT, CIP NO. P25-01

  The City Council is requested to accept the completion of the Fiscal year 2024-25
  Pavement Rehabilitation Project CIP No. P25-01.
  Recommendation:

  The City Council is requested to:

  1. Accept project completion for the Fiscal Year 2024-25, Project No. P25-01 as
  performed by Onyx Paving Company, Inc. for a total amount of $5,475,688;
 City Council Agenda

  2. Authorize the City Manager to file a project Notice of Completion with the County
  of Los Angeles Registrar-Recorder; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager to release a retention payment of $273,784 to Onyx
  Paving Company, Inc. within 35 days following recordation of the Notice of
  Completion.

  Attachment:  Staff Report (PDF)

  C. APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS (BID PACKAGE) AND
  AUTHORIZATION TO INVITE BIDS FOR LAS TUNAS DRIVE AWNING
  INSTALLATION PROJECT (CIP NO. P24-06)

  The City Council is requested to approve the plans and specifications and authorize
  the invitation for bids for the Las Tunas Drive Awning Installation Project.

  Recommendation:

  1. Approve plans and specifications (bid package) for the Las Tunas Drive Awning
  Installation Project; and

  2. Authorize staff to advertise the project for bids.

  Attachment:  Staff Report (PDF)

  D. ACCEPTANCE OF FOOTHILL TRANSIT BUS STOP ENHANCEMENT PROGRAM
  GRANT FUNDS, ADOPT CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT P27-09, AND
  APPROVAL OF AN AGREEMENT WITH BRASCO INTERNATIONAL FOR THE
  PURCHASE OF BUS SHELTERS

  The City Council is requested to accept the Foothill Transit Bus Stop Enhancement
  Program Grant Funds and approve an agreement for the purchase of bus shelters.
  Recommendation:

  1. Authorize the City Manager to execute the Grant Agreement (Agreement)
  between the City of Temple City and Foothill Transit for participation in the Bus
  Stop Enhancement Program (BSEP) in the amount of $40,000 for bus stop
  improvements;

  2. Adopt Capital Improvement Project (CIP) number P27-09 for the procurement and
  installation of new bus shelters consistent with the scope described in the BSEP
  Agreement; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement with Brasco International for
  the procurement of bus shelters for subsequent installation by the City, in an
  amount not to exceed $36,000.

  Attachment:  Staff Report (PDF)

  E. AUTHORIZATION FOR THE PURCHASE OF A MOBILE EMERGENCY
  GENERATOR, INSTALLATION OF A MANUAL TRANSFER SWITCH, RENTAL OF
  AN INTERIM PORTABLE GENERATOR, AND APPROVAL OF A $309,715
  BUDGET ADJUSTMENT FROM GENERAL FUND RESERVES

  The City Council is requested to authorize the purchase of a mobile emergency
  generator, installation of a manual transfer switch, and rental of an interim portable
  generator.

  Recommendation:

  1. Authorize the purchase of one mobile emergency generator, manual transfer
  switch, and associated equipment from Cummins Inc., through its competitively
  solicited Sourcewell cooperative purchasing contract, for emergency backup
  power operations, with a not to exceed amount of $215,000;

  2. Approve the installation of the manual transfer switch at the Live Oak Park
  Community Center, in the amount of $25,000;

  3. Authorize the City Manager to approve contingency expenditures in an amount
  not to exceed ten percent (10%) of the procurement and installation cost for
  unforeseen conditions, in the amount of $24,000;

  4. Authorize the rental of a portable emergency generator from United Rentals, Inc.,
  in the amount of $45,715, through its competitively solicited Sourcewell
  cooperative purchasing contract, to provide interim emergency backup power
  capability until delivery of the Cummins mobile emergency generator; and

  5. Authorize the City Manager to execute all necessary agreements and purchase
  orders for the procurement and installation of the equipment.

  Attachment:  Staff Report (PDF)

  F. RATIFICATION OF EMERGENCY PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF
  REPLACEMENT PUMPS AT THE ROSEMEAD BOULEVARD PUMP STATION

  The City Council is requested to ratify the emergency purchase and installation of
  emergency pumps at the Rosemead Boulevard pump station.

  Recommendation:

  1. Ratify the emergency procurement and issuance of a Purchase Order to
  PumpMan SoCal in the amount of $85,790 for the purchase and installation of
  two replacement stormwater pumps and associated equipment at the Rosemead
  Boulevard Pump Station; and

  2. Authorize the City Manager to execute any necessary documents and take such
  other actions as may be necessary to complete the emergency work.

  Attachment:  Staff Report (PDF)

  G. VISA CARD REPORT

  The City Council is requested to review, receive and file the Visa Card Report.

  Recommendation:  Receive and file the Visa Card Report.

  Attachment:  Staff Report (PDF)

  H. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 26-5902 APPROVING PAYMENT OF BILLS
  FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-26

  The City Council is requested to adopt Resolution No. 26-5902 authorizing the
  payment of bills for fiscal year 2025-26.

  Recommendation:  Adopt Resolution No. 26-5902 authorizing the
  payment of bills for fiscal year 2025-26.

  Attachment:  Staff Report (PDF)

  I. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 26-5903 APPROVING PAYMENT OF BILLS
  FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026-27

  The City Council is requested to adopt Resolution No. 26-5903 authorizing the
  payment of bills for fiscal year 2026-27.
